items.name: pill
items.title: Pill
items.description: Domain-tone variant of Badge for status, signal, and stage tags. Tones: neutral, sage, terracotta, amber, rose. `sage` and `terracotta` are historical labels that resolve to the brand accent (cyan in Operator/Blueprint, emerald in Field).

items.name: page-header
items.title: PageHeader
items.description: Title block at the top of every screen. Optional eyebrow, H1, optional subtitle, optional action slot, optional back link. H1 picks up Fraunces serif inside Blueprint scope via the `--page-heading-*` tokens.

items.name: ai-block
items.title: AIBlock
items.description: Card variant marking AI-generated or AI-curated content. Cyan halo (ring + faint glow), sparkle eyebrow with the AI label, optional regenerate button. Cyan is the global AI signal; renders correctly across all themes.

items.name: loading-steps
items.title: LoadingSteps
items.description: Multi-step AI loading sequence with three states per step (done / active / pending). Driven by the useAILoad hook.

items.name: readiness-tag
items.title: ReadinessTag
items.description: Qualitative diligence outcome with five states: Strong, Solid, Worth a closer look, Limited evidence, Not assessed. Resolves by explicit `tag` prop or by `score`. Two sizes: default for inline lists, lg for partner-detail headers.

items.name: view-source-pill
items.title: ViewSourcePill
items.description: Marks data flowing in from a VIEW corporate partner. Cyan in every theme — in Field this reads as foreign, providing the load-bearing visual for cross-workspace data provenance.

items.name: top-nav
items.title: TopNav
items.description: Workspace chrome — brand mark, active-workspace pill, primary tab nav for the active workspace, workspace switcher, avatar. Workspace is derived from the current pathname.
